fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Bharathi Ammal received calls demanding Rs. 25,000 with warnings of consequences if the amount was not paid. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2025-08-21, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-21 at about 15:15. Ramya Bai (9000000232) reported the matter for Bharathi Ammal, whose contact number is given as 9000000228. Abirami Sekar (9000000186) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Siva Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000256. Jagan Raman (mobile 9000000369) was named as a possible person of interest. The account reference SYN-ACC-100055 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records, social media screenshots and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Mobile phone record; Social media screenshot; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly demanded money with threats of consequences.
fields.Keywords: extortion, money demand, witness, screenshot, phone records, residential colony, mobile number, associate
